alloy: all u: Unit | miscited[u] implies u in Misnesting
all a: Axiom, v: Unit | (cites[a, v] and v not in Axiom) implies a in Misnesting
all f: Fact | (some u: Unit | cites[f, u]) implies f in Misnesting
all b: Bug, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i not in Known) implies b in Mistracking
all b: Bug, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) implies b in OutdatedTracking
all b: Bug | (some Runner and not tested[b]) implies b in Untesting
some Runner implies (all c: Claim | unguarded[c] implies c in Untesting)
all g: Tag | (no u: Unit | g->u in Name.tag) implies g in Rotting
all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding
all c: Claim, s: Site | (c->s in Name.site and (no o: Source | o->s in Hold.symbols)) implies c in Mislocation
all d, e: Document | d->e in Extend.rel implies (d->e in Context.rel and (all f: Document | e->f in Context.rel implies d->f in Context.rel))
all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
all t: Test, b: Bug, s: Spec | (checks[t, b] and b->s in Sit.rel) implies s not in Untesting
no Runner implies (all u: Unit | u not in Untesting)
all u: Unit | no Tracker implies u not in Untracking
all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
doubt: 'an undefined key' read as Foreign, 'a misplaced setting' as Stray, 'a looping extension' as Looping.

alloy: all f: Misquoted | f in Refused
all f: Foreign | f in Refused
all f: Unclosed | f in Refused
all f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p] implies p in Unfound
(some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) implies (all r: Run | r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all d, e: Document | d->e in Bare.rel implies (d.(Hold.units) = e.(Hold.units) and (d in Finding iff e in Finding))
doubt: 'differ only in frontmatter' read as one being the other without its frontmatter (Bare.rel); it could also mean both share a bare form.

alloy: all d, e: Document | d->e in Bare.rel implies d.(Hold.units) = e.(Hold.units)
all d, e: Document | d->e in Bare.rel implies (d in Finding iff e in Finding)

some a: Axiom, s: Spec, t: Test, g: Tag, d: Document, i: Index | s->a in Sit.rel and t in Declared and t->g in Carry.rel and g->s in Name.tag and d->a in Hold.units and d->s in Hold.units and d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d in Match.rel and (all x: Thing | x not in Finding)
all u: Unit | (u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Current
all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Unsayable and u not in Generated) implies u in Handwritten
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Reported
all r: Run, c: CheckCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Reported) implies r not in Exits0
all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
doubt: Each item read as the word kind sig (Undeclared, Misplaced, Apart, Unused) rather than spelled out through Voice/Introduce/Rely.

alloy: all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d1 in Checked and d2 not in Checked and d1->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units) implies u not in Rewritten
all s: Scenario | s in Possible implies s not in Raised
all s: Scenario | s in Raised implies (all u: Unit | u->s in Frees.rel implies s->u in Blame.rel)
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel implies u->s in Frees.rel
all u: Unit, w: Signature | (u in Logical and u not in Term and loneOn[u, w]) implies u->w in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies (u in Logical and u not in Term and w in Signature and loneOn[u, w])
some s: Scenario | s in Impossible and s in Raised and (some u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel and u->s in Frees.rel)
some u: Unit, w: Signature | u in Logical and u->w in Rely.rel and u->w not in Expose.rel
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst) implies l in OneLine
all q: Quantifier | (q in VariableWithCondition and fits[q]) implies q in RelativeClause
all q: Quantifier | q in VariableTwice implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach implies q in InFull
all l: Series | l in RelativeBeforeLast implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in NotClause implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in AndInOr implies l in KeepsAndApart
some d: Definition | d in OneKind and d in NotAboutSubject
doubt: 'alternatives of one kind' read as OneKind (all alternatives of one kind).

alloy: some d: Definition | d in OrInsideKind and d in NoKindFirst
some l: Series | l in Few and l in CommaItem and l in MoreThanTwo

(always all o1, o2: Owner, c: Cleanup | (dispose[o1] and o1 in o2.parent and o2 not in Disposed and c in Registered and c not in Ran and o1 in c.on) implies (not runNow[c] until dispose[o2])) and (always all o3, o4, o5: Owner | (dispose[o3] and o3 in o4.parent and o3 in o5.parent and o4->o5 in Birth.order and o4 not in Disposed and o5 not in Disposed) implies (not dispose[o4] until dispose[o5]))
always all c: Failing, o: Owner | (runNow[c] and o in c.on and o in Disposed) implies ((always o not in Threw) and (some o.handler implies eventually o.handler in c.reached))
doubt: 'the dispose of the owner never throws' read as the owner never being in Threw from then on.

alloy: some o1, o2: Owner, f: Failing | o2 in o1.handler and eventually (dispose[o1] and o1 in f.on and eventually (runNow[f] and eventually o2 in f.reached))
